document: R5-Q RESULT — the EFFICIENCY limb: how cheaply G reaches the base's success (理 11364)
bar_pre_registered: the smallest budget whose success >= 18.7% (the base's own 300 at budget 12)
ALL_IN_ACCOUNTING: every head row charges R2b's MEASURED controller cost of 2487.9 tokens/episode ON TOP of its model tokens. The ladder's raw JSON is model-tokens-only and says so; these are the numbers any frontier claim must use.

THE_EFFICIENCY_RESULT.G@6: 24.0% at 5,979 ALL-IN tokens — 12.8% CHEAPER than the base AND 5.3 points better. ⚠️ BORDERLINE: CI [+0.3, +10.3] barely excludes zero and McNemar p = 0.052 does NOT clear 0.05. The pre-registered bar (success >= 18.7%) is cleared; the CLAIM that G@6 beats the base is not established at conventional significance.
THE_EFFICIENCY_RESULT.G@8: 27.0% at 7,034 ALL-IN — +2.6% compute, essentially compute-NEUTRAL — +8.3 points [+3.0, +14.0], McNemar p = 0.0046. THIS is the clean statement of the efficiency limb.
THE_EFFICIENCY_RESULT.the sentence I would print: at essentially equal total compute (+2.6%) the head is 8.3 points better than the base [3.0, 14.0], p = 0.005; and it still exceeds the base's success while spending 12.8% LESS, though that cheaper point is borderline.

NON_MONOTONICITY_CHECKED_NOT_ASSUMED.observation: G@10 = 35.0% scores HIGHER than G@12 = 31.7% — the measured system's own budget was not its best point.
NON_MONOTONICITY_CHECKED_NOT_ASSUMED.the test: paired, same 300: +3.3 points, 95%% CI [-1.7, +8.3], McNemar p = 0.237
NON_MONOTONICITY_CHECKED_NOT_ASSUMED.reading: NOT ESTABLISHED. The interval contains zero. G@10 looking better than G@12 is not distinguishable from noise here, and I am not claiming a peak. It is worth printing only as 'success is flat across budgets 10-12', not as an optimum.

bounds: One seed (v3 seed 21), one model, 300 problems per point, paired per problem against the SAME base.
EACH BUDGET IS A DIFFERENT AGENT — the budget is in the prompt; no row is a truncation of another.
The controller cost is R2b's measured figure for the MEASURED system (k separate full-prompt passes). A cheaper controller would move every head row left and only strengthen this.
The bar was 'success >= the base's 18.7%'. Clearing a bar is not the same as a significant difference, and G@6 is exactly the case where those two readings diverge.
